newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB rises, CL Laing ups forecast.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB rises, CL Laing ups forecast.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Lloyds TSB Group Plc rose by 3.5 pence to 619.5 pence by 0835 GMT on Tuesday and Credit Lyonnais Laing said it had upgraded its earnings forecasts for the bank.
CLL's banking analyst Johnny de la Hey said he had upped the earnings forecasts for Lloyds TSB for the next three years by 100 million stg.
His forecasts were 3.09 billion stg for 1997, 3.471 billion stg for 1998 and 3.893 billion stg for 1999.

He said the upgrade was a result of cost savings from the Lloyds merger with TSB coming through faster than originally anticipated and Cheltenham & Gloucester producing above market mortgage share without a deterioration in its margins.
"The mortgage business is clearly doing very well," he said, adding he favoured Lloyds TSB above recently floated building societies Alliance & Leicester and Halifax Plc, as well as Abbey National.
